latest_release.name: v66.13.0
latest_release.body:
###    🚀 Features

- **autocomplete**: Implement minimal LRU cache for autocomplete suggestions  -  by @Jungzl in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5402 [<samp>(76d8c)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/76d8c0fbb)
- **ci**: Add core benchmark PR comments and upgrade Node@24  -  by @zyyv in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5415 [<samp>(c4f6d)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/c4f6d7fa0)
- **core**: Export sortRules  -  by @hexlabelposition in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5439 [<samp>(2c9b3)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/2c9b3f4ae)
- **eslint-plugin**: Support Oxlint JS plugins  -  by @hexlabelposition in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5432 [<samp>(1929d)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/1929d25f5)
- **inspector**: Add interactive docs tab driven by the project config  -  by @AndrewBogdanovTSS and @zyyv in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5425 [<samp>(19916)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/199162ac1)

###    🐞 Bug Fixes

- Enable noEmit to support allowImportingTsExtensions  -  by @zyyv and @hexlabelposition [<samp>(67a03)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/67a038eb0)
- **astro**:
  - Avoid duplicated dev styles by using a path id for the entry  -  by @Jungzl in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5406 [<samp>(72906)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/72906fb1f)
- **autocomplete**:
  - Declare @unocss/core as a runtime dependency  -  by @hyrious in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5422 [<samp>(eb06b)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/eb06b79a7)
- **cli**:
  - Generate css on startup in watch mode  -  by @hexlabelposition in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5434 [<samp>(80891)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/8089143a7)
- **cli,preset-wind4**:
  - Sort theme variables and globbed files  -  by @Jungzl and **thelastbackspace** in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5459 [<samp>(76bb0)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/76bb061af)
- **inspector**:
  - Stop counting safelist per module and merge aliases by declarations  -  by @AndrewBogdanovTSS and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5418 [<samp>(55102)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/55102d50c)
  - Keep the client in packages built by pkg.pr.new  -  by @AndrewBogdanovTSS in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5431 [<samp>(4ce61)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/4ce61cbef)
  - Apply transformers in the standalone host before extracting  -  by @AndrewBogdanovTSS in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5430 [<samp>(c24f0)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/c24f09260)
- **language-server**:
  - Clear stale state after settings change  -  by @hannoeru in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5456 [<samp>(962d5)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/962d5c84c)
- **preset-wind4**:
  - Generate working containment utilities  -  by @clean99 in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5400 [<samp>(1b957)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/1b957cddf)
  - Scope theme and property tracking per generator  -  by @0froq in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5460 [<samp>(6cbc9)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/6cbc9a14b)
  - Apply child selector after peer/group variants  -  by @abu-tahir-0 in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5454 [<samp>(312ae)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/312ae3dd3)
- **runtime**:
  - Skip regenerating css when no new tokens are extracted  -  by @hexlabelposition in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5398 [<samp>(b513a)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/b513adf23)
- **virtual-shared**:
  - Handle empty pipeli
